# Combat recordings — Pink Wars 3.63.10

All nine sources are CC0-1.0. Public domain dedication: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

- Kenney, **Impact Sounds**: metal light 002, medium 002, heavy 000. https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
- SpringySpringo, **Gun reload sounds**: mechanical action, via OpenSpades Rifle/RaiseLocal.opus. https://opengameart.org/content/gun-reload-sounds
- Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras, Matthew Nanney, **The Free Firearm Sound Library**: shotgun H_21P, via OpenSpades Shotgun/V2AmbienceSmall.opus. https://opengameart.org/content/the-free-firearm-sound-library

Retrieved 2026-10-25. Primary source licence declarations checked with web research. Licensed mirrors: https://github.com/euuuuuuan/voidclad-public/blob/main/CREDITS.md and https://github.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/blob/main/License/Credits-pak001-Free.md . Only the individually credited CC0 files are used; other OpenSpades shotgun sounds have different licences and are excluded.

Original and converted SHA-256, download URLs and transformations are in manifest.json. Metal original hashes matched the mirror's per-file register. No runtime request to an external sound bank. Sources remain mono for directional mixing. Existing Kenney laser layers retain their own provenance in ../kenney/.

Added 2026-10-26: Rifle/Fire1 (A_42P), Rifle/FireLocal (B_16P), Rifle/Fire2 (A_42P) and SMG/FireStereo (AR-15/D_24P), all individually credited CC0 in the mirror register. Short rifle transients are adapted as fictional R9, BLOOM, LANCE and robot-emitter bodies; these are not claimed to be recordings of fictional weapons. Loudness, duration, conversion and hashes are documented per file.

2026-10-27 / 3.63.12: the M12 blast now uses Winchester Model 12, K_17P.wav, from the prepared Free Firearm Sound Library. Source is the fps-asset-kit mirror; the accompanying Prepared Master Sheet describes a 12-gauge pump-action gunshot. A 1.05-second excerpt starts just before the first discharge, at 0.89 s, with mono conversion, 65 Hz high-pass, -4 dBFS peak and 150 ms fade. This replaces the former short CD/H_21P ambience tail, and remains CC0. Original/derived hashes are in manifest.json.
